profile.headline: Machine Learning Engineer at UnitedHealth Group | MS in Data Science @ NYU CDS

positions.title: Technology Development Program Developer
positions.description:
- Designed the first graph database using OrientDB at the company branch, leading to increased sitewide visibility for the project team

- Built a dashboard to house data visualizations and generate business report figures using C#, DB2, and SQL, resulting in the acquisition of 2 business partners

- Created data cross validation feature between lines of businesses, resulting in $50,000 saved annually

positions.title: Secretary
positions.description:
-Secretary for the Information Technology and Informatics Club at Rutgers

-Maintained the mailing list and other avenues of communication to ensure fluid conversation between the executive board and other members of the organization

-Communicated with Rutgers staff on behalf of the executive board on matters regarding the council

-Coordinated with alumni and other parties interested in holding networking events and speaking to students of the Rutgers IT and CS departments
positions.insights: Skills: Communication · Event Planning · Leadership · Organizational Development

positions.title: Technology Development Program Intern
positions.description:
- Built a CI/CD Automated Pipeline over the course of 11 weeks in Groovy using Jenkins and Pega, resulting in an estimated cost avoidance of $493,350 yearly

- Performed integration testing on code through the pipeline using Sauce Labs

- Presented the CI/CD Automated Pipeline project to the Optum COO

positions.title: Information Technology Help Desk
positions.description:
-Installed operating systems and reformatted computers as needed 

-Provided computing-related support to the over 44,000 members of the University of Illinois community

-Ensured the security of information for over 100 computers in the computer labs by monitoring usage and being aware of any questionable activities within the lab

-Mentored newer recruits in the day-to-day operations of a Site Consultant as well as oversaw their growth

-Performed the printing and sales of poster requests

-Managed supplies for 5 computer labs

positions.title: Teacher
positions.description:
-Oversaw the education of children aged 10 to 15 years in Mathematics and English

-Created lesson plans and planned the daily activities of the students in order to ensure that classes ran smoothly

-Created tutorials in Scratch

positions.title: Secretary
positions.description:
-Maintained patient information in a database of over 2,000 patients

-Interacted with patients - scheduled appointments, collected payments, and stored sensitive patient information
